latest_release.name: FeurStagram v456-0-0-24-78
latest_release.body:
FeurStagram settings are now one tap away from your profile, and the app nags you less: updated to Instagram 456.0.0.24.78.

## ✨ New
- **A FeurStagram button on your profile.** Tap the diamond icon at the top of your profile, next to the ☰ menu, to open the FeurStagram settings. Long-pressing the Home icon still works, as before.
- **A red dot when an update is out.** The dot stays on that button until you update, and the settings open on an "Update available" row.
- **Threads button hidden.** The Threads shortcut at the top of your profile is gone. You can bring it back in Blocked surfaces.

## 🐛 Fixes
- **The update page shows up once a day at most.** It no longer comes back at every launch; the red dot reminds you in between.
- **No more "follow the official account" card after updates.** It is only shown once, right after a new install.
- **Mutual followers load again.** The "Mutual" tab of a profile's followers no longer stays empty when suggested accounts are blocked.
- **Swiping no longer lands on hidden pages.** On Instagram 456, swiping from Home could open the hidden Reels page; it now skips to the next visible page again.

## 🔧 Under the hood
- Updated to Instagram 456.0.0.24.78.
- Suggestions shown on a profile's follower lists ("For you") are no longer hidden: they come in the same response as the mutual followers.
- Both APKs keep the existing release signature and update in place.
